skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Robes for the Saintess meticulously crafted by the Vine-Bead Court.
Made by the finest tailors of Kjerag. She has grown, now far more cool-headed than when she first ascended to her post.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Warm but heavy clothes. As she walks, bells chime.
This blessing shall be with her forevermore.
